name: WebWerk Contact Chat Widget
author: Mohammad Loutfi

sections.description:
WebWerk Contact Chat Widget adds a floating contact widget to your WordPress website.

The plugin can be used to display a contact button for WhatsApp, phone, email or custom links. Site visitors can use the widget to contact you directly from your website.

It is lightweight, easy to configure and designed for performance and usability.

Features

  • WhatsApp Click-to-Chat button
  • Phone, email, and custom contact links
  • Modern floating chat-style interface
  • Customizable texts and messages
  • Customizable widget colors
  • Customizable header, button and message box colors
  • Adjustable delay before showing the widget
  • Show on desktop and/or mobile
  • Page targeting using include/exclude URLs
  • Lightweight and fast loading
  • No external dependencies
  • Demo mode if no contact data is configured

Additional Information

A separate Pro plugin with additional integrations and customization features may be available on the developer website.

The free version available on WordPress.org is fully functional and does not require a license key.

More information:
https://www.webwerk-muenster.de/webwerk-contact-chat-widget/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/webwerk-contact-chat-widget directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to “WebWerk Chat Widget” in the WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enter your contact details.
  5. Save your settings.
sections.faq:
Do I need WhatsApp Business?

No. A normal WhatsApp number is enough.

Does it work on mobile devices?

Yes. The plugin is optimized for both mobile and desktop.

Can I change the widget colors?

Yes. You can customize the header, widget background, message box, button and text colors.

Why do I see a demo chat?

If no contact information is entered, the plugin shows a demo mode so you can preview the widget.

Does this plugin slow down my website?

No. The plugin is lightweight and only loads the required assets.
